results.question: What is the fee refund timeline?
results.raw_answer: The university refunds tuition and fees according to a 16‑week schedule tied to the date of withdrawal: • Before the first day of classes – 100% of tuition and 100% of fees are refunded. • During Week 1 (Add/Drop period) – 100% of tuition and 100% of fees (except health‑insurance fees) are refunded. • During Week 2 – 80% of tuition and 50% of fees are refunded. • During Week 3 – 60% of tuition and 0% of fees are refunded. • During Week 4 – 40% of tuition and 0% of fees are refunded. • After Week 4 – no tuition or fee refunds are provided. Room and board charges are refunded on a daily prorated basis up to the end of Week 4; after that no housing/dining refunds are issued.
results.reasoning_note: Chunk 0016 explicitly lists the refund percentages by week, which directly answers the timeline question.

results.question: What is the hostel vacation policy?
